description: Source file implementing various functionalities related to UBUS communication, including managing linker entries, resolving references, preparing responses, handling asynchronous requests, and event handling within a network service context.

methods.name: void add_linker_entry(struct async_request_context * ctx,const char * linker_path,const char * linker_value)
methods.description: Adds a new linker entry to the context, duplicating and storing the path and value.

methods.name: void free_linker_entries(struct async_request_context * ctx)
methods.description: Frees all linker entries associated with the context, deallocating memory.

methods.name: void fill_blob_param(struct blob_buf * bb,const char * path,const char * data,const char * type)

methods.name: void resolve_reference_path(struct async_request_context * ctx,char * ref_path,char * output,size_t output_len)
methods.description: Resolves a reference path, potentially using linker entries or directly querying for reference data.

methods.name: void prepare_and_send_response(struct async_request_context * ctx)
methods.description: Prepares the response data as a blob message and sends it via ubus reply.

methods.name: void send_response(struct async_request_context * ctx)
methods.description: Finalizes and sends the response, unregisters event handlers, cleans up linker entries, and completes the request.

methods.name: struct:blob_attr * get_results_array(struct blob_attr * msg)

methods.name: void append_response_data(struct ubus_request_tracker * tracker,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Appends response data from a message into a temporary blob buffer.

methods.name: void handle_request_timeout(struct uloop_timeout * timeout)
methods.description: Handles timeout for a pending ubus request, potentially aborting and cleaning up.

methods.name: void ubus_result_callback(struct ubus_request * req,int type,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Callback to process ubus reply messages, appending data to the response buffer.

methods.name: void ubus_request_complete(struct ubus_request * req,int ret)
methods.description: Callback invoked when ubus request completes, managing request state and final response.

methods.name: void run_async_call(struct async_request_context * ctx,const char * ubus_obj,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous ubus call with the given context and message.

methods.name: void send_linker_cleanup_event(struct ubus_context * ctx)
methods.description: Sends an event to clean up linker entries.

methods.name: void linker_response_callback(struct ubus_context * ctx,struct ubus_event_handler * ev,const char * type,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Handles linker response events, updating the context with linker data.
